title: Extending Han–Pedon (2026): proof of Conjecture C for metallic Hankel determinants (arXiv:2610.36132v1, p. 6)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Extending Han–Pedon's lower-shift results (2026), we prove their Conjecture C (arXiv:2610.36132v1, p. 6): for every n ≥ 1 and ℓ ≥ n+3, every residue subsequence of the shifted q-metallic Hankel determinants is a rational polynomial, from its first term, with period 2n(n+1) for even n and 4n(n+1) for odd n. Each polynomial is integer-valued on all integers. A complementary-minor formula reduces the determinant to a matrix of fixed size with polynomial dependence on the number of continued-fraction periods. We give a degree bound, rational generating functions, constant-coefficient recurrences and periodicity from the first term modulo every positive integer at every shift. Exact complementary-minor identities and the degree bound prove the affine laws extending Ovsienko–Pedon's golden shift-4 pattern (2023; published 2025).
summary: Every higher-shift residue is polynomial from m=0 and integer-valued on Z. Consequences include rational generating functions, linear recurrences, all-shift composite-modulus periodicity without a transient, and certified golden shift-4 affine laws.

coverage.lean_statement: Existence of the integral metallic series; all n ≥ 1, all ℓ ≥ n+3, every residue modulo the stated period, all m ≥ 0; the residue polynomials are integer-valued at every z in Z.
written_proofs: Degree at most t(t-a)+a(a-1), with a=ℓ-(n+1), K0=ceil((r+a)/rho), t=K0*rho-r
Period rho*M*lcm(1,...,max(1,d)) modulo every integer M ≥ 1 at higher shifts; all lower shifts are rho-periodic
Integral rational generating function numerator of degree less than rho*(d+1) over (1-z^rho)^(d+1); recurrence (E^rho-1)^(d+1)
Polynomial-growth dichotomy from the residue laws
